# Cursor Changelog — captured 2026-06-09

## June 5, 2026 (Version 3.7) — Design Mode Improvements + SDK enhancements [already reported]
- Design Mode: multi-select elements in browser; voice input to narrate UI changes while agents run.
- SDK (TS & Python): custom tools passed directly via local.customTools without separate MCP servers; auto-review routing of local tool calls through a classifier; JSONL/custom stores for agent persistence; nested subagents that can spawn subagents at any depth.
- Canvas: Design Mode for canvases; interactive context-usage reports.
- Enterprise Organizations: orgs as top-level containers with team/group management; multi-team roles; org-level usage analytics + IDP management.
- Reliability: requestId run correlation; HTTP/1.1 cloud streaming; lighter SDK imports.
(Below watching-tier major-capability bar; already reported in prior reports.)

## May 29, 2026 (Version 3.6) — Auto-review Run Mode [reported 2026-06-01]
New run mode allowing the agent to work longer with fewer approval prompts. Applies to Shell, MCP, and Fetch tool calls: allowlisted calls run immediately, sandboxable calls run in an isolated sandbox, others route to a classifier subagent.

## May 20, 2026 (Version 3.5) — Shared Canvases
Teams share interactive agent artifacts via browser links (read-only). External/cross-team sharing surface.

## May 20, 2026 (Version 3.5) — /loop Skill
Agents run a prompt repeatedly on a local schedule until an outcome is achieved.

## May 20, 2026 — Improvements to Cursor Automations
Automations in Agents Window; multi-repo + standalone configs; new templates.

## May 19, 2026 — Cursor in Jira
Assign work items to cloud agents or @Cursor in Jira comments; generates PRs.

## May 18, 2026 — Composer 2.5
Upgraded Cursor model.

## May 13, 2026 (Version 3.4) — Full-screen Tabs and Compact Chats
## May 13, 2026 — Development Environments for Cloud Agents (multi-repo)
## May 11, 2026 — Cursor in Microsoft Teams (@Cursor mentions)
## May 7, 2026 — Build in Parallel / /multitask

Updated: 2026-06-09 — Newest is 3.7 (June 5); already reported, below watching-tier bar. No net-new since prior scan.
